lesson.title: Idiom: ਦੁੱਧ ਦਾ ਦੁੱਧ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: ਅੱਜ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੁਹਾਵਰਾ! (Today, the second idiom!) A well-known Punjabi idiom about getting to the clear, honest truth.

The idiom is ਦੁੱਧ ਦਾ ਦੁੱਧ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ (dudh da dudh, paani da paani). New word: ਦੁੱਧ (dudh, milk) — you already know ਪਾਣੀ (paani, water). Literally, this means 'milk as milk, water as water' — separating two things that might have been mixed together back into their true, separate identities. The real meaning: to sort out the full truth of a confusing or disputed situation, clearly separating what's true from what's false, so nothing stays mixed up or unclear. Think of a situation where 'sorting out milk from water' — figuring out the real truth — would matter.
You now know a second real Punjabi idiom about clarity and truth. Tomorrow we'll learn a third idiom, and use all three in your own writing.

objectives: Learn the idiom ਦੁੱਧ ਦਾ ਦੁੱਧ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ, its literal meaning, and its real meaning
Apply the idiom to a real or invented example situation
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's idiom.
2. Introduce today's idiom, its literal words (ਦੁੱਧ/ਪਾਣੀ), and its real meaning.
3. Have the child think of an example situation involving sorting out the truth.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's topic: a third idiom, plus using idioms in original writing.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just recognizing and translating the idiom, without requiring an original example yet
Ready for more: ask them how this idiom's imagery (milk and water separating) makes its meaning easy to picture and remember
All Gurmukhi words/phrases used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. Literal meaning: milk as milk, water as water. 2. Real meaning: to sort out the full, clear truth of a confusing situation. 3. Answers will vary for the child's own example situation.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Teaches a second real, well-known idiom with complete literal-vs-real analysis, building the idiom vocabulary the course description names.
